messages.text: At 16¢ a kWh, the unit I'd put you on is the Harlo B30 — $899, ~30 TH/s, and buyable today, ships Nov 30. The H15 Dual drop isn't open yet. Is this your first miner?
B30 at 360–450 W runs you about $41–52 a month at 16¢, for ~30 TH/s and around 50 dB — quiet enough for a home office. Per TH, the Magic Miner 40T ($799) is our best value. What are you running now?

Got it. Then the real choice is the B30 at $899 (BM1373, 30 TH/s, ships Nov 30) or the Magic Miner 40T at $799 — more hashrate, cheaper, best value per TH, ships November 21. Was the dual-coin side of the H15 the draw, or just the hashrate?

Efficiency: the B30 does 30 TH/s on ~360–450 W (~13 J/TH), roughly $41–52 a month at 16¢. The Magic Miner is tunable — 30 TH @ 450 W ($52), 40 TH @ 650 W ($75), 50 TH @ 850 W (~$98).

If watts per TH is your priority, the B30 wins. Want me to set it up?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Harlo H15 Dual numbers for where you live.
